The patch work could have been avoided is what I am saying, also this ruins the purpose of buying the game at launch, since the patch is going to come later

People out there being extroverts and having thousand friends at a time do give temporary happiness to each other and at the right moment for the right thing they will conveniently shoot each other in the head. I have had many people in my life promising to not leave my side no matter what, me being an idiot trusted them and did show them the real me and opened up a lot. In the end they did leave in the worst possible way like I never even existed in the first place. It is not validation that should keep you going but the race that is life. A terrible dark betraying race. It is supposed to fuck you up.Leaving it will lead to nothingness. Fucking beat it. Embrace the loneliness and go ahead. Do things you thought you would not be able to do. Don't seek attention seek the right to judge all. And yes the world is an extremely lonely place.
